name: Döge (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Döge: a white and blue shield with a church, a plant and a pruning knife, within a wreath of ears of grain, above a scroll inscribed DÖGE KÖZSÉG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Döge arms with wreath and scroll
